title: Map your lit review mid-conversation to surface the underlying debate
description: Claude reads your stack of papers and draws the argument structure inline — clusters by claim, tension lines where camps disagree, blind spots per group.
prompt: I've read 20 papers on AI in K-12 and I've lost the thread. Can you map out who's actually agreeing with who and where the real disagreements are? I can't tell anymore which papers are building on each other and which are talking past each other. If I click into a group, give me the short version of what they've got and what they're missing.
steps: Give Claude context (attach papers or notes)
Claude creates argument clusters with blind-spot analysis
Follow up prompts to refine, expand, or explore further
prerequisites: Optional: Google Drive connector for direct paper access
Optional: Projects feature for multi-week reviews
